content: RAI architecture rests on three abstractions: Agents (run()/stop(), hold Connectors), Connectors (pub/sub, service, action communication; ROS2Connector is the ROS2 one, ROS2HRIConnector handles multimodal human I/O), and Tools (LangChain-compatible, wrap Connector calls). rai_whoami extracts embodiment info (URDF, docs, images) into a system prompt via EmbodimentInfo.from_directory(). Agents are NOT themselves rclpy nodes -- the ROS2Connector inside them owns the actual node/pub/sub; agent logic (ReAct loop) is separate from ROS2 plumbing. Source: robotecai.github.io/rai docs, github.com/RobotecAI/rai, deepwiki.com/RobotecAI/rai.
